$comment: Six tasks chosen because each one is a failure mode this pipeline was built to survive. Keep it small — this set runs on every change; full.json is the opt-in sweep.

tasks.why: The core case. A finished social post with real copy — the result must BE the design, not a backdrop with room left for text.
tasks.userPrompt: instagram post announcing our new student mentorship programme

tasks.why: The invented-discount trap. An advert with NO copy supplied; anything the model writes is invention.
tasks.userPrompt: an advertisement for our university admissions service

tasks.why: Three words. Tests whether the system infers strong direction from the brand instead of producing something thin.
Must stay wordless. A picture request must never acquire type, a logo or a layout.
tasks.userPrompt: a photograph of a student reading in a sunlit library

tasks.why: An explicit user colour direction must EMPTY the brand palette, not be blended with it.
tasks.userPrompt: black and white editorial poster for our alumni night

tasks.why: A clearly branded surface — the one case where the logo belongs, placed and reproduced faithfully.
tasks.userPrompt: billboard for our new campus with our logo on it
